name: FinMME
description: FinMME is a benchmark dataset for financial multi-modal reasoning evaluation, containing over 11,000 high-quality financial research samples across 18 financial domains and 6 asset classes with diverse chart types. It includes FinScore, an evaluation system with hallucination penalties and multi-dimensional capability assessment to provide unbiased and robust evaluation of multimodal large language models in finance.
reputation: FinMME is a recent finance multimodal benchmark that is gaining attention as a more rigorous evaluation suite for financial VLMs.
notes: Dataset covers 10 major chart types and 21 subtypes; evaluation system designed to penalize hallucinations and assess multiple capabilities; shows challenging nature for state-of-the-art models.
